title: A total spectacle at SUPER CUP ATTP – SUMMER 2025!
body_html:
The first stage of the table tennis tournament turned the TOP CUP Academy arena into a true stage of passion, ambition and sporting elegance. In a vibrant atmosphere, every match was a display of commitment and mental strength, confirming once again that this competition is more than just a tournament — it is a celebration of the ATTP spirit.

The hosts, TOP CUP Academy, together with the tournament referees, shone with their professionalism and openness, creating an environment where fair play and performance went hand in hand. The public rewarded every spectacular rally with thunderous applause, and emotions peaked in the deciding matches.

The heroes of Stage I – the winners of each group:

Group E: 🥇 Boian Ion | 🥈 Demian Fiodor | 🥉 Uzun Alexandr

Group D: 🥇 Gașlama Alexandr | 🥈 Țurcanu Roman | 🥉 Corghencea Radomir

Group C: 🥇 Capbătut Petru | 🥈 Veremiichuk Yaroslav | 🥉 Casapciuc Stanislav

Group B: 🥇 Nazaria Sergiu | 🥈 Burucenco Vadim | 🥉 Pascal Igor

Group A: 🥇 Ying Demik | 🥈 Bobeico Igor | 🥉 Mandatari Nichita

Beyond the standings, this first stage was a clear statement: passion for table tennis is the engine that unites the ATTP community and inspires every player to get better.
